Q5467.reason: Ordinary speeding that causes death is unlawful-act or negligent-homicide involuntary manslaughter; the facts show no intent for voluntary manslaughter and no extreme recklessness amounting to malice for murder.

Q5471.reason: A builder-seller of a new home impliedly warrants good and workmanlike construction and habitability, so caveat emptor and a one-year strict-liability rule do not control.

Q5472.reason: Standard static-stretch guidance (including ACSM) is to hold each stretch about 10–30 seconds for most adults.
